title: Cmd+V pastes 10,000 lines into a program that takes bracketed paste: every line arrives, in order, once; nothing hangs
why: Pasting a long log or file into an editor or a REPL is everyday use. 10,000 lines (about 140 kB) go from the pasteboard through the app, the daemon and the PTY, which applies back pressure; a lost, repeated or reordered chunk, a confirmation dialog for a program that asked for bracketed paste, or a hung app are each a broken paste.
